extracted.name: Apple Spice Dump Cake
extracted.description: This apple spice dump cake recipe is made with apple pie filling, cake mix, cinnamon, nutmeg, allspice, and pecans for a fabulously easy fall dessert.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C.)
Pour apple pie filling into a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Whisk sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, and allspice together in a small bowl until well combined; sprinkle over pie filling. Cover filling with dry cake mix; dot with butter, then scatter pecans on top.
Bake in the preheated oven until top is browned and filling bubbles on the sides, 45 to 60 minutes.
